description: Lists current promotions (sales and offers) that retailers in WEM's Awin affiliate programmes have published, for the shopper's market. Filter by merchant or by words in the offer. Each row gives the offer, its dates and a tracked link. A promotion is not a price, and it is not a discount on a product unless its terms say it covers that product. Checkout codes are shown only where the retailer's programme lets WEM publish them; other matching promotions are counted by reason in `withheld`, and a withheld code may still exist. An empty result covers only these programmes, not every offer a retailer runs.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the shopper's market: GBP (default) or USD. Promotions are regional, so this decides which market's offers are read.

merchant.description: Retailer name, e.g. "iHoverboard". Omit for every retailer.

query.description: Words that must appear in the offer, e.g. "hoverboard" or "free delivery".

name: search_promotions

outputSchema.description: Promotions the retailer published to its affiliate network, filtered by WEM’s programme terms. A promotion is the retailer’s claim about some of its range, not a price — never compute a discounted price from it unless its terms name the product.

disclosure.description: WEM’s affiliate disclosure for this answer, written to be quoted as it is. Its wording changes with the rows: it states whether every outbound link is affiliate-tracked, only some are, or none are. A version from an earlier answer may not fit this one: a row marked `affiliate: false` earns WEM nothing.

links.description: The tracked links from `promotions`, pre-formatted. Give these to the user when you name a promotion.

market.description: ISO country code the promotions were read for.

promotions.description: Ending soonest first. Each row is one live promotion WEM is allowed to show.

endsAt.description: When the retailer said it ends. Null means no end was stated — do not invent one.

kind.description: code rows carry `code`, and appear only where the retailer’s programme lets WEM publish it.

terms.description: The retailer’s own conditions. Relay them with the offer.

url.description: WEM tracked redirect to the retailer’s promotion page. The full URL; a shortened or rewritten form is a different link.

reason.description: Present only when no promotion is shown. None of these means the retailer has no offer on — not_configured and upstream_error mean WEM could not look.

search.description: Present when this result names no offer. `url` is WEM's results page for the query and `markdown` is the same link, pre-formatted. WEM searches retailers live on that page, including shops it holds no affiliate programme with, so an empty or withheld result here is not evidence the product is unavailable or unpriced.

withheld.description: Matching promotions WEM did not show, counted by reason: notPublishable (a checkout code or offer the retailer’s programme does not let WEM publish; the code may well exist), notJoined, notActive, outsideMarket, noTrackedLink, otherPublisherLink, incompleteRecord.

withheldNote.description: Quote this rather than paraphrase it when codes were withheld.

title: Find current retailer promotions
